scope.definition: First-class public gateways, connected applications, connected specialist applications, backstage platform systems, and declared legacy/reserved modules in the Verve N Veda ecosystem.
scope.embeddedContentPolicy: Individual courses, lessons, games, documents, and small embedded utilities remain source-owned by their parent application manifests and are not duplicated here.
scope.versionPolicy: A version is only populated when a version is explicitly declared by the source. Unknown versions remain null; they are never inferred from dates or repository history.

rules: NAIB is the public/front-line AI identity.
NOEMA is backstage only and must never be presented as the public/front-line AI.
NOEMA governs orchestration, permissions, memory, identity, evidence standards, security, provider boundaries, and specialist authority.
NAIB may expose results and route users to specialists without revealing NOEMA as a public destination.
Specialists retain their own identities and authority boundaries; NAIB does not impersonate them.

statusDefinitions.current: Current product or system in the canonical ecosystem.
statusDefinitions.current-local: Current browser/local-first application; some networked capability requires backend services.
statusDefinitions.handoff-ready: Current specialist that receives structured handoffs but is not directly integrated for execution.
statusDefinitions.manifest-discoverable: Current source discoverable through machine-readable manifests.
statusDefinitions.restricted: Current capability intentionally gated by account, permissions, or infrastructure.
statusDefinitions.backstage: Current internal orchestration/governance system; not a public navigation destination.
statusDefinitions.reserved: Repository/module exists but is not yet a published app.
statusDefinitions.legacy-active: Historical lineage retained and intentionally still reachable.
statusDefinitions.legacy: Historical/superseded implementation retained for lineage or archive purposes.
statusDefinitions.development-collection: Development/prototype collection without a canonical root public landing.
